facts.text: Serve dessert when Mrs Wilson brings out the cookies.
facts.why: No cookies or Mrs Wilson serving them in the transcript or plot. At the Floraganza party Dennis hits the garage door button and upends the dessert table.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Dennis's garage door sends the dessert table flying.

facts.text: Mr. Wilson, I brought you a cookie to say sorry about your garden. I only ate a little bit of it on the way over.
facts.why: Not found among Dennis's lines on the quote page, and printed in quote marks as his words. As a note Dennis might write it is true to the plot, because he wrecks the night of the flower and has to say sorry. The flower, not the garden, is what he ruins.
facts.fix: Dear Mr. Wilson, sorry about the flower. I brought you a cookie. I only ate a little bit of it on the way over.

fix_note.text: Dear Mr. Wilson, sorry about the flower. I brought you a cookie. I only ate a little bit of it on the way over.

vibe.verdict: Right neighbourhood and a good Mr Wilson tone, but the cookie cue is not backed by the sources and the Dennis note is invented.
